title: One Way or Another
writer: Julio García Espinosa, Tomás González Pérez, Tomás Gutiérrez Alea
actors: Mario Balmaseda, Yolanda Cuéllar, Mario Limonta
plot: In Miraflores, Cuba, the growing romance between Mario, a factory worker, and Yolanda, a schoolteacher, throws into relief the differences in their perspectives and values in Revolutionary Cuba.
